'''Sha'Dria''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] bartender who worked for [[Yin Vocta]] at his nightclub, the [[Bantha Traxx]], on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. She always hid her face behind a mask that she called [[N'Noch]], and would refer to everyone else as being one of "The Unmasked."

==Biography==
[[Yin Vocta]]'s two [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], [[Haelon Tice]] and [[R'Kayza]], protested hiring her, but Vocta was too intrigued to listen. She operated one of the three cooling stations called "Oasis" and she quickly became a big draw turning the Oasis into the most popular of the three. Tice once tried to become overly friendly with her and that resulted in him losing a hand.

She was secretly a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] deep cover agent who had been working at Bantha Traxx to uncover information about Yin's underworld empire. When she discovered enough to warrant extraction, she signaled a distress code.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Personality and traits==
Sha'Dria was a physically attractive woman who hid her face behind an intricately designed mask. She was a good listener and had good advice to dispense to her patrons. She was intriguing enough to capture the attention of Yin who hired her in hopes of unraveling her mystery.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sha'Dria was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. She was illustrated by [[Brian Schomburg]].
